passages.title: How to avoid sports injuries
passages.text:
Regular exercise is one of the best things you can do for your health. However, every year thousands of young people are hurt while playing sports. Many of these injuries could be avoided with a little preparation.

Before you start …
• Warm up for at least ten minutes. Light jogging and stretching increase blood flow to your muscles and make **<u>them</u>** less likely to tear.
• Wear the right shoes for your sport. Running shoes, for example, are designed to absorb the shock when your feet hit the ground.
• Drink water before, during and after exercise, especially on hot days.

While you are playing …
• Don't push yourself too hard if you feel pain. Pain is your body's way of telling you that something is wrong.
• Use safety equipment, such as helmets and knee pads, when you cycle or skate.

After exercise, cool down slowly with gentle stretching. And remember: rest is important too. Muscles get stronger while you are resting, not while you are training.
